response: Saved Views is available today for all customers, included in every paid plan at no extra cost. Keeping track of the same filters, sorting, and grouping every time you open a project can slow your team down. Now you can capture that exact configuration once and return to it instantly, whether you're tracking overdue tasks, reviewing this sprint's backlog, or monitoring a specific teammate's workload. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize views across different projects, clients, or workflows without losing track of any of them. Views aren't limited to your own workspace, either: any view can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of rebuilding filters from scratch. This makes onboarding new teammates faster and keeps reporting consistent across the board. Whether you manage one project or dozens, Saved Views helps your team spend less time configuring and more time getting work done. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
